clue.text: Swede given support thus in South Africa?

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

indicators.note: the word for thus is placed inside the abbreviation for South Africa

parts.note: sic is Latin for thus, used to mark a quotation as printed

explanation.surface: A Swedish person is offered help in South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swede' looks like a person from Sweden, but it is the root vegetable, one of the cabbage family.
explanation.definitionFit: The swede is a root vegetable of the cabbage genus, so it is one example of that plant group.

clue.text: But we hope his won't be a put-up job!

definitions.text: But we hope his won't be a put-up job!

parts.words: But we hope his won't be a put-up job!
parts.note: a put-up job is a fraud, but literally it is something erected, which is exactly what a constructor of houses does

explanation.surface: Someone hopes a particular person's work is not a swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: A construction worker's job is literally putting things up, hence the play on a rigged scheme.

clue.text: They authenticate extremely ancient silver coins

indicators.note: extremely means take the extreme letters, first and last, of the word ancient

parts.note: a tester was an old silver coin, originally a Tudor shilling, later a sixpence

explanation.surface: Experts verify very old silver money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' looks like an intensifier for 'ancient', but it takes that word's first and last letters, A and T. A tester was an old English coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Witnesses who certify a document or signature are the people who vouch that it is genuine.

clue.text: Funny alien

definitions.meaning: funny in the sense of odd or peculiar
alien in the sense of foreign, unfamiliar

explanation.definitionFit: Both odd (funny-peculiar) and foreign or unfamiliar are standard senses of the word.

clue.text: Note shirt tail is missing and ply the needle

indicators.note: is missing says a letter is taken away from the word for the note

parts.note: a crotchet is a musical note, a quarter note

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter, here of shirt

explanation.surface: Sewing advice: the shirt's tail has gone, so get stitching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is missing' removes T, the last letter of 'shirt' (its 'tail'), from CROTCHET.
explanation.definitionFit: This craft makes fabric by looping yarn with a hooked needle, so it is one way to work a needle.

clue.text: Equipment seen on the football field

definitions.meaning: a challenge for the ball in football or rugby

explanation.surface: Gear spotted on a football pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Fishing gear is called by this name, and so is a player's challenge to take the ball in football.

clue.text: Go on board to get audio equipment

parts.note: a go is a turn, as in a turn in a game
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: Climbing aboard to collect some hi-fi gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go on board' reads as boarding a vessel; 'on' just joins the two pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: The rotating deck of a record player is part of a hi-fi system.

clue.text: It calls us towards Ayrshire, perhaps

definitions.text: It calls us towards Ayrshire, perhaps

parts.words: It calls us towards Ayrshire, perhaps
parts.note: read 'us' as spoken by Ayrshire cattle: the clanger hung round a beast's neck summons the herd

explanation.surface: Something beckons us to a Scottish county.
explanation.walkthrough: Ayrshire is a Scottish county, but also a breed of dairy cattle; 'perhaps' marks it as one example of a breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell hung round a beast's neck rings so the herd can be located or summoned.

clue.text: Cough cure originally thought up in an English county

indicators.note: in puts the opening letters inside the abbreviated county name

parts.note: Lincs is the abbreviation of Lincolnshire, an English county

indicators.note: originally means take the first letters of thought and up

explanation.surface: A remedy for coughs was first devised somewhere in England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes T and U from 'thought up'; 'in' places them inside LINCS, short for Lincolnshire.
explanation.definitionFit: A syrupy medicine taken to soothe a sore throat or cough.

clue.text: Unwanted visitor in Bury — one bounding along!

parts.note: to inter is to bury
a loper is one who runs with a long bounding stride

explanation.surface: An unwelcome guest in a Lancashire town is a leaping figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bury' looks like the Lancashire town, but it is the verb INTER.
explanation.definitionFit: An intruder who pushes into a place or group where they are not welcome.

clue.text: Player in air force unit

definitions.meaning: a winger in football or rugby, a player out on the flank
a formation of several squadrons in an air force

explanation.surface: A sportsman serving in the RAF.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a flank position in team sports and a body of squadrons share this name.

clue.text: Removal of illusions experienced by Cinderella at midnight?

definitions.meaning: at midnight the fairy godmother's spell broke, literally lifting a magic spell

explanation.surface: Disillusion, as felt by the fairytale heroine when the clock struck twelve.
explanation.definitionFit: Disillusion is literally being freed from a magic spell, which is what happened to the fairytale heroine at the stroke of twelve.

clue.text: Again choose to see City square after dance

indicators.note: after puts the City and square pieces behind the dance

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance
EC is the postcode area of the City of London
a T-square, so T

explanation.surface: Someone goes to view a city plaza after a dance and votes again.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, postcode EC.
explanation.definitionFit: To vote someone back into the office they already hold.

clue.text: Anxiety about a little scroll-like ornament

indicators.note: about means the word for anxiety goes round the other piece

parts.note: care in the sense of worry
a touch means a small amount

explanation.surface: Worrying about a small decorative scroll.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little' is one piece, as in 'a touch of salt'; no separate A is needed.
explanation.definitionFit: An oval or scroll-shaped frame or carved panel used in architecture and on Egyptian inscriptions.

clue.text: A high ball when rejected is hard to get rid of

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the word for the high ball reads backwards

parts.note: a lob is a high looping ball in tennis or cricket
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A lofted shot, once turned away, is tough to clear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when rejected' turns LOB into BOL.
explanation.definitionFit: To do away with something entirely, such as a law or practice.

clue.text: Dull man in a tie, possibly

indicators.note: possibly says the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A man wearing a necktie may be boring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges MAN IN A TIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lifeless, without spirit or animation, so lacking in liveliness.

clue.text: Runner — a burgeoning celebrity?

parts.note: a celebrity just budding is a star in bud, and those words placed one inside the other give a large bird that runs rather than flies

explanation.surface: An athlete who is an up-and-coming star.
explanation.walkthrough: A star in bud is BU-STAR-D, a large ground bird known for running.
explanation.definitionFit: This large heavy bird of open plains prefers running to flying.

clue.text: Its strings are perpendicular honest!

definitions.meaning: a piano whose strings run vertically, as opposed to a grand
honest in the sense of morally sound

explanation.surface: A piano whose strings stand straight is a trustworthy one.
explanation.definitionFit: A vertical-strung piano bears this name, and it also means morally straight.

clue.text: Piece for army commander involved with spiteful woman

indicators.note: involved means wrapped up inside the word for army

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, the British reserve army
OC is Officer Commanding
a cat is a spiteful woman

explanation.surface: A musical work for a general alongside a nasty woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The Territorial Army is Britain's volunteer reserve; 'involved' places the commander and the cat within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard composition showing off a player's touch, so a musical work.

clue.text: Attract fish back to the sheltered side

indicators.note: back means the word for attract and the fish are read backwards together

parts.note: to draw is to attract
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: Tempt a fish back toward the calmer side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns DRAWEEL around.
explanation.definitionFit: The side away from the wind, the side in its lee.

clue.text: The way, without the gas turned up, to prepare pasta

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the way goes round the other piece

parts.note: a lane is a way or road

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the word gas is read upwards, backwards

explanation.surface: Instructions for making pasta without the gas on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, not lacking; in a down clue 'turned up' reads the gas from bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: Flat sheets of pasta, or the baked layered dish made with them.

clue.text: Foretaste showing seriousness of intention

definitions.meaning: an advance token or pledge of more to come
being serious and sincere, as in the phrase in dead seriousness

explanation.surface: A preview that shows you mean business.
explanation.definitionFit: A pledge or deposit given as a token of what is to follow, and a sincere, serious state of mind.

clue.text: Pronounced difference of opinion in attack

indicators.note: pronounced means the word is spoken, giving one that sounds alike

parts.note: dissent is disagreement

explanation.surface: A marked disagreement during an offensive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pronounced' looks like 'marked', but it signals a sound-alike.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden raid or swoop, as in a descent on the coast, is an assault.

clue.text: Think hard, perhaps, about leaving Corsican bankers

indicators.note: perhaps says the remaining letters might be arranged differently
leaving says the letter for about departs from the fodder

parts.note: C, from circa, means about

explanation.surface: Consider hard whether to leave the island's bankers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaving' takes C (circa, 'about') out of CORSICAN BANKERS; 'perhaps' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain one's mind trying to remember or work something out.

clue.text: Fragrant centre in Uttar Pradesh

indicators.note: centre picks out the middle four of the eight letters of fragrant

explanation.surface: A sweet-smelling spot in an Indian state.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as 'a city in Uttar Pradesh', home of the Taj Mahal.
explanation.definitionFit: This northern Indian city, site of the Taj Mahal, lies within that state.

clue.text: Gather for farewell right inside this entrance

indicators.note: inside puts the letter for right within the word for farewell

parts.note: a conge is a formal farewell or leave-taking
a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: People assemble to say goodbye at a gateway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' puts R inside CONGE, a dated word for a farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: To assemble or come together in a crowd.

clue.text: Set out to involve airmen in bombardment

indicators.note: to involve means to enclose the airmen inside
out means the letters of set are disordered

parts.note: RAF, the Royal Air Force

explanation.surface: Mounted a raid including air crew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set out' reads as departed, but 'out' scrambles the letters of 'Set'; 'to involve' wraps them round the airmen.
explanation.definitionFit: An attack with machine-gun fire from low-flying aircraft, so a heavy shelling.

clue.text: Undergarment intended, say, for wearing in church

parts.note: a vest is an undershirt

indicators.note: say signals a word that sounds like another

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: A piece of underwear meant for church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' signals a sound-alike: MEANT sounds like MENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremonial robe worn by clergy during services.
